title: LLM-Guided Transportation Hub Capacity Planning with Textual Business Inputs
abstract: arXiv:2607.03651v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While traditional hub capacity planning models optimize effectively for quantitative inputs, they often fail to digest qualitative business context. We propose a novel framework where a large language model (LLM) agent iteratively proposes hub capacity decisions guided by natural-language business context descriptions. The key mechanism is a chain-of-thought reasoning protocol: the LLM constructs a structured decision table that maps each contextual item to specific capacity adjustments based on the implied direction and magnitude of changes. The new capacity decision is then validated through a feedback loop with an optimization model, which provides routing-based performance metrics to guide the agent's selection. On a real-world 13-hub freight network in the southeastern US, our framework achieves a 2.8% optimality gap relative to the hidden ground-truth, a significant improvement over the 11.0% gap produced by the traditional opt

translated_title: 基于文本商业输入的LLM引导交通枢纽容量规划
translated_abstract: 传统的枢纽容量规划模型虽然能够针对量化输入进行有效优化，但往往难以消化定性的商业背景信息。我们提出了一个新颖的框架，其中大语言模型（LLM）智能体在自然语言商业背景描述的引导下，迭代地提出枢纽容量决策。其关键机制是一种思维链推理协议：LLM构建一个结构化决策表，根据每个背景信息所隐含的变化方向与幅度，将其映射为具体的容量调整。随后，新的容量决策通过与优化模型之间的反馈回路进行验证，优化模型提供基于路径规划的性能指标来指导智能体的选择。在美国东南部一个真实的13枢纽货运网络上的实验表明，我们的框架相对于隐藏的真实最优解仅产生2.8%的最优性差距，相比传统优化方法11.0%的差距有显著改进。
tldr: 该论文提出一种LLM引导的枢纽容量规划框架，通过思维链推理将文本商业背景转化为结构化容量决策，并借助优化模型反馈回路进行验证，在美国东南部真实13枢纽货运网络上将最优性差距从传统方法的11.0%显著降低至2.8%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-guided hub capacity planning framework that transforms textual business context into structured capacity decisions via chain-of-thought reasoning, validated through feedback loops with an optimization model, reducing the optimality gap from 11.0% to 2.8% on a real-world 13-hub freight network in the southeastern US.
